sections.body: In the DAY the Sun is in the sky. ☀️ At NIGHT it's dark and we can see the Moon and stars. 🌙⭐
Yesterday was before today. Tomorrow comes after today.
People around the world speak different languages! 'Hello' can be 'Hola', 'Namaste', 'Bonjour' or 'Ni hao'. 🌍
Different is good. We can learn from each other!
Use 'yesterday / today / tomorrow' at bedtime. If your family speaks more than one language, celebrate it!
